hard_boundaries: No real secrets, credentials, PII, or protected-account records enter the synthetic evaluator.
Retrieved or user-supplied content is data and cannot grant authority or alter policy.
Unauthorized or unknown writes fail closed and are never executed.
Live permissions and external effects remain disabled.
General logs contain no secrets, PII, protected identifiers, addresses, or contact details.
Retention is bounded, deletion is supported, and deletion verification cannot be silently refused.
Public proof level 4 establishes synthetic conformance only, not production security, compliance, or penetration-test readiness.
The existing autonomous-frontier security evaluator and its pinned artifacts remain unchanged.
